description: Department of Elections - Extend the date of Poll of Puthukudiyiruppu and Maritime Pattu Pradeshiya Sabhas fixed for 24.03.2012 by the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1744/8 of 08.02.2012 and appoint 28.02.2015 as the date for taking of the Poll
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the extension of a polling date for Local Authorities elections, as issued by a Returning Officer under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content focuses on electoral processes (rescheduling an election date) and falls squarely within the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which covers election announcements, schedules, and related electoral commission decisions.
